description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Unlucky Cabbage Merchant, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, adding {C}{C}.
When Unlucky Cabbage Merchant dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Unlucky Cabbage Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Unlucky Cabbage Merchant enters, its first ability triggers, creating a Food token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Food, adding {C}{C}.
Unlucky Cabbage Merchant's second ability triggers. Holding priority, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve the Unlucky Cabbage Merchant trigger from step 5, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped. You will not shuffle Unlucky Cabbage Merchant as it's a new object.
Repeat from step 4.
